content: {"summary":"fraud-scorer-02 was OOMKilled every ~11 min because gunicorn started 32 workers on a 32‑core node (WEB_CONCURRENCY unset), exceeding its 3 GiB limit; setting WEB_CONCURRENCY=16 stopped the kills.","likely_cause":"Gunicorn spawned too many workers (32) due to missing WEB_CONCURRENCY, causing memory over‑commit and OOM.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"WEB_CONCURRENCY was unset, so gunicorn started one worker per CPU (32) on the node","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#1"],"quote":"WEB_CONCURRENCY is not set in the Deployment, so the entrypoint starts one gunicorn worker per CPU it can see: 32."},{"text":"Each warmed‑up worker uses ~150 MiB, so 32 workers exceed the 3 GiB pod limit","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#2"],"quote":"A warmed-up worker holds about 150 MiB."},{"text":"Setting WEB_CONCURRENCY=16 reduced workers and eliminated OOM","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#1"],"quote":"WEB_CONCURRENCY=16 set in the Deployment; rollout"}],"next_checks":["Verify the current Deployment has WEB_CONCURRENCY set to match container memory limits","Monitor per‑worker memory usage after the change","Check that new pods inherit the corrected worker count on any future node rotations"]}
